remote-settings-v2-rollout.userFacingDescription:
Rollout to transition clients to remote-settings v2 API, which will be made default in code for the next updates and releases.
Remote Settings is responsible for delivering content updates like blocklists, translation models, background images, certificate bundles, etc.
The v2 public uses a transparent git-based storage layer and is faster to scale.
